title: Lake of Happiness
description: In a small Belarusian village where time seems to stand still, Jasja, a 9-year-old girl, has to deal with her mother‘s death. Her father decides to send her to an orphanage. But one day she decides to run away home.
music: painter Louis is experiencing strange events. His world seems to be mutating. Slowly
and people become less real. They deconstruct
disintegrate. A poignant stop motion about Alzheimer’s disease which was nominated for an Academy Award.
